subject: Checking end-of-quarter priority for Redwood pilot / StellarApps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@stellarapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pilot recap + next steps (pricing attached)

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

What we heard:
- Goal: reduce decision latency for customer support responses and embed summarization into agent workflows.
- Priority: POC this quarter, ideally a lightweight pilot in staging with a view to production for Q3.
- Constraints: procurement review + SOC2 evidence will be required; budget needs to be approved by end of month.

Pilot scope we recommended:
- 2-week proof-of-value using Redwood hosted API (staging data, obfuscated PII)
- Integration points: support ticket enrichment + real-time summarization (low-latency path)
- Success metrics: avg latency < 300ms for 90th pct, summary relevance > 85% on sample prompts

Next steps:
1) I attached a short pricing sheet for the pilot (redwood-pricing-mvp.pdf).
2) Marissa (cc'd) can run a short tech session with your SRE/infra to confirm integration approach — can you share 30 minutes next week?
3) If procurement needs a list of security artifacts, I can send our SOC2 checklist and evidence matrix (see note below).

Open question: is end-of-month still the timeline you mentioned for budget/prioritization? That will help us proposed a concrete kickoff date.

Happy to jump on a quick call — propose Tue 6/16 or Thu 6/18.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-pricing-mvp.pdf (pdf, 2 pages)

Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot recap + next steps (pricing attached)

Aditya —

Thanks for the recap and the pricing sheet. This aligns with what we discussed. A few quick notes from my side:
- I'll need to loop in Nina from procurement for the budget sign-off and contract review (cc'ing her now).
- We'll definitely need the SOC2 checklist and any standard data handling docs for our security review.
- Timeline: we still have an internal push to make a Q2 decision but procurement has been fairly backed up; hoping to get clarity before 6/30 but could slip a week.

Would be great to schedule the tech session with Marissa next week — can you do Wednesday 6/17 at 11am PT?

Thanks,
Liam

liam@stellarapps.com | 212-555-0199
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Redwood pilot recap + next steps (pricing attached)

Liam / Nina —

Great — thanks for looping Nina in. 

Nina: for procurement/security, I've attached our SOC2 evidence checklist and a short note on data handling (SOC2-evidence-ask.docx). High-level answers to likely questions: 
- Data residency: pilot can run in US regions; for production we support dedicated VPC/private deployment.
- PII handling: we recommend obfuscation in pilot, and we have built-in masking + audit logs.
- Audit logs / retention: configurable; we can provide sample retention policy.

Marissa — can you confirm availability for Wed 6/17 11am PT for a 30-min tech sync?

If procurement wants a redlineable SOW/PO terms to accelerate approval, we can draft a short pilot agreement (1 page) once scope is locked.

Thanks,
Aditya

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-ask.docx (docx, 1 page)

Subject: Quick end-of-quarter check-in — is the pilot still a priority?

Hi Liam —

Wanted to check in quickly as we're at the end of the quarter. I haven't seen confirmation from procurement yet and wanted to ask if the pilot is still a priority on your side and whether budget/approval timing is still expected by 6/30.

If priorities shifted, no worries — would appreciate a quick note so we can re-align timing on our side. If it helps move things, we can:
- Reserve a pilot slot in July and hold pricing for you for 14 days, or
- Offer a short introductory credit to cover the first week of usage while procurement completes approvals.

Happy to do a 15-min sync today or tomorrow to unblock anything — short availability: 9:30am PT or 3pm PT.

Thanks,
